title: Amazon PPC management
intro: Give your advertising a clearer focus.
copy: Amazon Sponsored Ads management for brands and manufacturers. Focus your campaigns on the products with the strongest potential, while freeing up time to run your business.
items: Product-first advertising
The original approach applies an 80/20 principle: prioritise the products with the strongest potential, then consider lighter campaigns for the rest of the range.
Expertise and technology
Combine hands-on campaign management with tools that help identify changes and guide ongoing optimisation.
More time for your business
Delegate the learning curve and day-to-day complexity of Amazon advertising to a specialist team.

sections.title: A focused approach to your advertising budget
sections.text: Start with your product range, identify priorities and agree an advertising approach around your goals. Campaign management focuses on relevant traffic and the commercial potential of your listings, without promising a particular ranking or return.

sections.title: Flexible working arrangements
sections.text: The original website describes month-to-month management with 30-day cancellation. Ask the team to confirm current notice periods, minimum budgets and management fees before starting.

title: Amazon consulting
intro: A fresh perspective. A practical next step.
copy: Project-based and hourly support for Amazon advertising, product listings, photography, competitor research and product opportunities.
items: Advertising strategy
Review existing campaigns, identify improvements or plan a campaign approach when you are starting from scratch.
Listing audits
Review titles, bullet points, descriptions and backend search terms, alongside keyword indexing and relevant search opportunities.
Training and research
Get training for yourself or employees, with competitor analysis and product opportunity research tailored to your needs.

sections.title: Choose the support your business needs
sections.text: The original consulting service includes both one-off projects and hourly advice. Discuss a focused brief or bring a broader challenge for the team to review.
bullets: Photo audits and advice on image testing
Training for business owners and employees

sections.title: Request current consulting rates
sections.text: Hourly and prepaid blocks were listed on the original website. Those historical prices have not been presented here as current rates. Contact the team for an up-to-date quote.

title: Amazon brand protection
intro: You built your brand. Help protect it.
copy: Support for brand owners dealing with counterfeit products, misleading claims and marketplace listing issues.
items: Brand Registry support
Discuss your brand’s registration and marketplace protection needs with the team.
Listing and brand integrity
Get help reviewing listing content, Buy Box issues and concerns about false or inaccurate claims.
Customer experience
Explore proactive customer service and ways to improve your brand’s visibility on Amazon.

sections.title: Protect the business behind your listings
sections.text: The original service covers fraud concerns, inaccurate reviews or claims, Brand Registry, listing control and customer service. Support depends on your circumstances and the tools available through Amazon.
bullets: Brand Registry and brand gating enquiries
Counterfeit, fraud and unauthorised distribution concerns
Listing content and Buy Box issues
False or inaccurate claims and reviews
Proactive customer service and positive brand visibility

title: Amazon account management
intro: Your Amazon business. Supported end to end.
copy: Comprehensive support for brands and manufacturers using Seller Central or Vendor Central.
items: Build the foundation
Keyword research, competitor analysis and listing copywriting help establish the basis for your Amazon presence.
Manage and refine
Combine PPC management with image and copy testing, listing updates, product variations and flat-file uploads.
Explore what comes next
Discuss product opportunities, Brand Registry support and expansion into international marketplaces.

sections.title: A connected approach to account management
sections.text: The original programme brings listing optimisation, advertising and testing together, then explores further opportunities as the business develops. Photography is coordinated with external specialists rather than produced in-house.
bullets: Seller Central and Vendor Central support
Brand Registry and international expansion support

sections.title: A scope built around your account
sections.text: The original website describes a recurring monthly fee with minimums. Ask the team for current availability, eligibility, scope and pricing.

title: Keyword research & copywriting
intro: Make your product story easier to find.
copy: Product listing support that brings keyword research together with clear, persuasive copy.
items: Research the search terms
Identify relevant product keywords to inform the listing’s copy and search terms.
Write the full listing
Create a title, benefit-led bullet points, a detailed description and backend search terms.
Refine the presentation
Discuss the optional photography component and revision process with the team.

sections.title: What the original service includes
sections.text: Native English-speaking copywriters work on the listing’s title, bullets and description, supported by detailed keyword research. The original offer also includes backend search terms and one copy revision.
bullets: Bullet points explaining features and value
Product descriptions and backend search terms
One revision as described in the original offer

sections.title: Copywriting and photography options
sections.text: The original website lists copywriting and photography options with volume-based pricing. Request a current quote and confirm photography requirements, deliverables and revision terms.

title: Amazon PPC audit
intro: Take a closer look at your advertising.
copy: A focused review of a product’s ad visibility and competitors, with practical recommendations.
items: Select a product
Review the product range and choose a top-performing product for closer analysis.
Compare ad visibility
Identify key competitors and examine a sample of advertising placements along the shopping journey.
Identify improvements
Receive a brief summary and recommendations specific to the product.

sections.title: Ask about audit availability
sections.text: The original website offered a free, manually prepared audit for a limited time. Contact the team to confirm whether that offer is still available before requesting it.
